segments.name: Precision components
segments.description: Makes precision components and assemblies for aerospace and defense prime contractors and the U.S. Government.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM") reviews financial performance and makes decisions on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Prime contractors and the U.S. Government pay for precision components and assemblies under fixed-price contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue is generated from fixed-price contracts.
